superseded_counting_domains_20260907.why: The registered witness non-degeneracy screen -- this document's own predicate, run unchanged -- disqualifies FORMAL_MATHEMATICS_1000PLUS. All 243 formal cases carry the single disposition FORMALIZABLE_AS_STATED; neither HYPOTHESES_MISSING_REOPEN nor STATEMENT_FALSE_OR_ILLFORMED_BLOCK occurs once. A constant witness cannot expose a wrong transfer (FM80 s3f). The markdown twin is NOT rewritten and its sha256 stands: the design was executed, not edited.
superseded_counting_domains_20260907.census_control: field-name census over all 243 formal hidden keys: decl 182 + decls 31 + url 30 = 243, so the absence claim has justified scope rather than resting on a search that merely returned nothing
superseded_counting_domains_20260907.mapper_correction: the first reading counted only decl/decls and reported 213 checkable + 30 uncheckable. The registered contract's witness is a machine-checked declaration in Mathlib OR A LISTED EXTERNAL FORMAL LIBRARY, and the 30 carry a url into an external Lean development. Corrected to 243/243 -- the correction makes the witness MORE constant, not less
superseded_counting_domains_20260907.attributed_stage: CASE_SOURCE. The formal pool was drawn from mathlib's 1000+ theorems tracking list, which by construction lists theorems that HAVE been formalized, so the adverse dispositions cannot occur in it. Not the eligibility predicate, not the arms, not the analysis.
superseded_counting_domains_20260907.consequence: FM80 s2.1 requires AT LEAST ONE mathematical/formal domain with a machine- or expert-checkable formal witness. Two empirical corpora cannot fill that slot, so three counting domains are unreachable on this pool even if the third domain screens perfectly. This is upstream of the third-domain question.
superseded_counting_domains_20260907.lever: an EXECUTABLE formal witness -- arm outputs checked by Lean, which FM80 s7 already contemplates ('formal cases use machine-checkable proof/test artifacts wherever possible') -- or a formal corpus carrying adverse formalization outcomes. Neither is a matter of more compute; both are a different witness class. Recorded as the lever, not as something attempted here.
superseded_counting_domains_20260907.third_domain_status: EMPIRICAL_ASSET_PRICING_OSAP remains SELECTED ON CRITERIA and is NOT ASSEMBLED. The reason is the domain-1 failure above, which is upstream of it -- nothing about OSAP. Assembling it could not move the terminal, and reporting a block after doing so would read as though the block were about OSAP.
superseded_counting_domains_20260907.not_a_scientific_verdict: no arm ran on the formal domain and none could. This is a property of the assembled pool, not of structural donor discovery or typed transfer, and it must never be reported as one.
superseded_counting_domains_20260907.terminal_label_class: DERIVED_DESCRIPTION__NOT_A_REGISTERED_TERMINAL. The `terminal` field below composes the registered per-domain terminal with FM80 s2.1. The amendment registered only WITNESS_DEGENERATE__CANNOT_EXPOSE_A_WRONG_TRANSFER (per domain) and FM80_S9_INSTRUMENT_WITHOUT_DYNAMIC_RANGE__NO_VERDICT_REACHABLE (programme, over three assembled domains -- not claimed here, only two were assembled). A label minted after an outcome must not stand where a registered terminal belongs; it is kept only because it names the cause more precisely, and it is marked.

third_domain.selection_order: criteria C1-C6 written and frozen BEFORE any candidate was screened; no candidate was scored before selection

criteria.C1: empirical science materially different from PSYCHOLOGY_RPP in objects, measurement semantics and strongest parent methodology; not formal/mathematical (FM80 s2.3)
criteria.C2: frozen, case-level, publicly documented replication/transfer witness produced by an independent party, not by this programme (FM80 s3f, s6)
criteria.C3: evidence layer separable from the verdict at case level (FM80 s3a, s3g) -- the discriminating criterion; this is what removed MLRC
criteria.C4: strongest known native parent method(s) nameable per case (FM80 s3b)
criteria.C5: >= 80 candidate cases before screening (headroom over the 61 bar; screening can only reduce)
criteria.C6: lawfully and publicly obtainable without authentication, machine-readable, snapshot-hashable (FM80 s11)

range_finding_probe.rationale: FG80 R3 (2026-09-06, same host, same channel) put all five arms at 80/80, exact p=1.0, terminal FG80_AT_CEILING_UNDER_A_CATEGORICAL_CONTRACT. FM80's endpoint is also categorical and s9.1 is also a percentage-point difference, so saturation would make the contrast unreachable by arithmetic no matter what else is built.
range_finding_probe.draw: deterministic seeded shuffle of case_id over research/experiments/sd80/SD80_CASE_MATRIX_CASES_V1.json
range_finding_probe.why_freeze_safe: the treatment arm never runs on this stratum, so no s9 contrast is observed; FM80 s8 already selects the comparison baseline by a pre-outcome rule based only on baseline identity, so baseline identity is explicitly not outcome information

routing_table.evaluated: per counting domain, in order; first matching row is the disposition

symbols.maj: accuracy of always answering the domain's majority witness class

rows.derivation: s9.1 requires A3 >= best + 0.10 and no accuracy exceeds 1.00, so best >= 0.90 makes the clause unreachable by arithmetic

witness_non_degeneracy.on_failure: WITNESS_DEGENERATE__CANNOT_EXPOSE_A_WRONG_TRANSFER -- fails FM80 s3f; not counted; NOT read as a negative

programme_level.binding_reading: an instrument terminal, recorded at that strength and NEVER as evidence that structural donor discovery or typed transfer adds nothing. A saturated or uninformative instrument is silent, not exculpatory.

order_of_operations: 1. this amendment merged to main, sha256 registered
2. reserved stratum drawn from the committed seed; witness non-degeneracy screen
3. range-finding probe (A0, A1 on the 60 reserved cases); routing table evaluated
4. branch: no range in >= 2 counting domains -> instrument terminal, stop; range present -> third-domain intake and s3 screening, Stage A, Stage B, Stage C, s9 gate
5. outcome receipt with the seed revealed and the served model id asserted
does_not: relax any s9 threshold (10 pp bar, exact paired test, Holm, s9.3 non-compensatory fidelity, s9.4/s9.7 all stand)
grant P-A or P-B a standalone route or change either disposition
substitute a machine surrogate for s4.4 remoteness adjudication
promise a verdict -- a registered instrument terminal or a stated failure to assemble the third domain honestly are both admissible outcomes
